name: purchase_work_acceptance
summary: Lets purchasing require a formal Work Acceptance sign-off before goods are received or vendor bills are created, so the company only pays for products and services that were approved. Work Acceptances are created from purchase orders and track due, received and accepted dates. The controls are switched on in Purchase configuration settings, and a Work Acceptance button and WA reference fields then appear on purchase orders, receipts and vendor bills.

name: purchase_work_acceptance_evaluation
summary: Adds quality scoring to Work Acceptances so each delivery can be rated against evaluation criteria the company defines itself. Criteria and their scores are set up in configuration, filled in on the Evaluation tab of a Work Acceptance, and summarized in a Work Acceptance Evaluation report.

name: purchase_work_acceptance_invoice_plan
summary: Lets you create Work Acceptances one installment at a time from a purchase order's invoice plan, so each payment installment is backed by an accepted quantity. When billing, the chosen Work Acceptance controls the invoiced quantity instead of the plan, and the plain Create Bill by Plan option is removed. The entry point is the Create WA by Installment button on the purchase order.

name: purchase_work_acceptance_late_fines
summary: Calculates penalties a vendor owes when a delivery is late, using the Work Acceptance due date and a fine rate per day. From the Work Acceptance the user can generate a fines invoice or refund, which posts to a configured late delivery fines revenue account. Fine rates and the account are set in Purchase configuration settings.

name: sale_purchase_force_vendor
summary: On a sale order line that uses a make-to-order style route, lets the salesperson pick which vendor must supply the item, so the automatic purchase order goes to that vendor. A company setting can restrict which vendors are allowed on sale lines, and the selected vendor is shown on the sales analysis report. Works through the Sales app and the Inventory routes.

name: stock_move_purchase_price_update
summary: Lets warehouse staff correct the purchase price of goods while receiving them against a purchase order, as long as that purchase order has not been invoiced yet. A Purchase Price column can be shown on receipt operations and their detailed operations. The change is made from the Receive Products flow on the purchase order.

name: supplier_calendar
summary: Gives each vendor a working calendar so supplier lead times are counted in working days instead of plain calendar days. The calendar is used when computing scheduled receipt dates on pickings and order dates on purchase orders. It is set up from the vendor record, using a resource working schedule defined in developer mode.

name: vendor_transport_lead_time
summary: Splits a vendor's delivery delay into supplier lead time and transport lead time, which are added together for the total. This lets purchasing see how much of the wait is transport so shipping can be planned. The split appears on vendor price list entries and on purchase order lines.

name: base_import_async
summary: Lets users run large CSV imports in the background so the screen does not hang while the file loads. A checkbox on the import screen queues the import, which is split into chunks, and any failure shows up as an error on the background job. Users can open the job queue to read the error.

name: queue_job
summary: Technical base module that lets Odoo run slow tasks in the background as queued jobs instead of making the user wait. It adds a Job Queue menu to view jobs, retry or cancel them, and control how many run at once through channels. Other modules use it, and developers postpone methods by calling with_delay().

name: queue_job_batch
summary: Groups related background jobs into one batch so they can be tracked together, for example 100 records processed as a single group. Running and recently finished batches appear from the systray, with counts of completed and failed jobs. It adds a batch field to each job.

name: queue_job_cron
summary: Lets a scheduled action run as a queued background job, optionally on a dedicated channel so that tasks which must not overlap run one at a time. It is enabled per scheduled action with the Run as queue job flag. Scheduled actions are a technical screen used for automated recurring tasks.

name: queue_job_cron_jobrunner
summary: Technical module that runs queued background jobs through scheduled actions, for hosting setups where the normal job runner cannot run, such as Odoo.sh. Jobs run on the scheduled-action worker threads, and this simple runner has no channel capacity or priority handling. It is not meant to be installed alongside the regular job runner.

name: queue_job_profiler
summary: Technical debugging aid that records performance profiles of selected background job functions, including SQL and stack trace data. It is enabled per job function from the Queue Job Functions screen, for chosen users and a time window. Results are stored in the profiler log for review by developers.

name: queue_job_subscribe
summary: Lets administrators keep users in the Job Queue Manager group without having them receive an email for every failed background job. A Job Notifications checkbox on the user form controls whether that user follows failed jobs. It is useful when many people share the manager role.

name: base_comment_template
summary: Technical base for predefined comment text printed on business documents such as quotations, invoices and delivery orders. Templates can be set per company, per partner and per model, filtered by a domain, and placed above or below the document lines. They are managed under Reporting comment templates in developer mode, and other modules build on this one.

name: bi_sql_editor
summary: Lets an administrator write a custom SQL query and turn it into a new reporting view, with its own menu, action and graph or tree views. The view can be materialized and refreshed by a scheduled task, and access can be limited to chosen groups and a domain. It appears under the Dashboards SQL Reports menu and is intended for technical users.

name: kpi
summary: Lets you define key performance indicators with good, warning and bad thresholds, computed from SQL queries or Python code on local or external databases. Values refresh automatically on a schedule and keep a history of past results, with a colored status for each range. It is designed to feed spreadsheet dashboards.

name: pdf_xml_attachment
summary: Technical helper for reading and embedding XML files inside PDF documents, such as the XML part of an electronic invoice. Other modules and developers call it from code, and there is no screen for end users. It can also be used outside Odoo through a Python utility.

name: report_context
summary: Technical setting that passes extra context values to a specific printed report, so the report can hide fields or change other options. Each report gets a Context Value field, which is filled in while in debug mode from the report settings. Developers then read that context inside the report template.

name: report_csv
summary: Technical base for producing reports as CSV files instead of PDFs. Developers add their own CSV report classes, and each report can set a text encoding such as cp932 for Japanese systems and how to handle characters that cannot be encoded. Users download the result like any other report.

name: report_display_name_in_footer
summary: Prints the name of the document, such as the order number, in the footer of every page of a PDF report, next to the page numbers. This helps readers match loose pages of a multi-page printout to their document. The list of models that get this footer is set in a system parameter, and the value all turns it on everywhere.

name: report_footer_html
summary: Lets you add custom HTML content, such as text or an image, to the footer of chosen printed reports. Set it on the report record under advanced properties, and adjust the bottom margin of the report paper format so the footer fits. Some layouts show the custom footer full width.

name: report_label
summary: Lets you print self-adhesive labels for any list of records, such as product or address labels, choosing how many labels each record gets and an optional starting offset. Label sizes are defined as label paper formats, and each label report is attached to a server action that prints the chosen records. Output is a PDF.

name: report_layout_config
summary: Lets you replace the header and footer of printed documents with full-page images, such as a letterhead. The images are set from General Settings under Document Layout by opening Configure Document Layout and choosing the layout images option. The images are stored per company.

name: report_partner_address
summary: Adds an Address Details field to contacts that can be filled in for each active language, and used in printed documents and the customer portal instead of the standard address when present. If left blank, the standard address format is used. Address Details is not passed on to child contacts.

name: report_pdf_form
summary: Lets you print fillable PDF forms with values pulled from Odoo records. You upload a PDF that has form fields, then map each form field to a field on the record or to a reusable variable. The filled form is produced as a report.

name: report_pdf_zip_download
summary: When several records are printed at once, creates one PDF per record and bundles them into a ZIP file instead of one combined PDF. Printing a single record behaves as normal. It is enabled per report with a Zip Download option under the report's advanced properties.

name: report_positioned_image
summary: Adds logos, watermarks or stamps to PDF reports at exact positions measured in millimeters, shown on every page or on the first page only. Company-level images can be included in any report that opts in, and reports can also carry their own images. Images are set up on the company record under a Report Images tab.

name: report_py3o
summary: Technical reporting engine that builds documents from LibreOffice templates (ODT or ODS files) and outputs PDF, Word, Excel or other formats. It lets non-developers design reports in LibreOffice, and users can receive an editable file. Templates are uploaded on each report's settings under the technical actions for reports.

name: report_py3o_fusion_server
summary: Lets an external py3o Fusion server handle document conversion and PDF export instead of a LibreOffice process on the Odoo server, for better speed. It adds PDF export profiles, for example PDF/A, watermarks, password protection and PDF forms, which are set on the server or on an individual report. It requires extra software to be deployed.

name: report_qr
summary: Improves how QR codes are printed on reports, giving a cleaner and better structured image than Odoo's standard QR code. Report templates call it with a path and can choose the error correction level. Useful for any printed document that carries a QR code.

name: report_qweb_element_page_visibility
summary: Technical styling helper that lets report designers show a header or footer element only on the first page, the last page, or all other pages of a multi-page PDF. It works by adding CSS classes to elements in the report templates. Typically used to repeat a document number on continuation pages.

name: report_qweb_encrypt
summary: Lets PDF reports be password protected. It is set per report, either with a password typed in when printing a single record, or with a password generated automatically from record data. Useful for sending confidential documents such as invoices.

name: report_qweb_field_option
summary: Lets administrators set how many decimal places numbers show on printed reports and views, and choose display options for fields such as a date format. Rules can be limited by unit of measure or currency and by a domain, and when several rules match the strictest one is applied. Configured under Technical Reporting QWeb Field Options.

name: report_qweb_parameter
summary: Technical helper for XML report templates that need exact field lengths, such as government e-invoicing formats. Template fields can be truncated to a maximum length or checked against minimum and maximum lengths, so invalid documents are caught before sending. It has no separate screen for end users.

name: report_qweb_pdf_cover
summary: Adds an optional front cover and back cover page to PDF reports, either as separate pages or overlapping the first and last pages of the document. It is enabled per report under advanced properties and can use uploaded cover PDFs. Useful for catalogs and formal reports.

name: report_qweb_pdf_watermark
summary: Adds a watermark or background image to every page of a PDF report, such as a draft stamp or a full-page background. The image is placed at the PDF level so it covers the whole page, and it can come from a PDF or image uploaded on the report, from an expression, or from the company watermark. It is set under the report's advanced properties and company information.

name: report_qweb_signer
summary: Digitally signs printed QWeb PDF reports with a company certificate (PKCS#12), so the document downloads already signed. Optionally the signed file is saved as an attachment, so later prints return the same copy with its original date. Certificates are uploaded under General Settings, Certificates and Keys.

name: report_substitute
summary: Lets you set rules so a printed report is automatically replaced by an alternative report when conditions are met, for example a different invoice layout for one company. Each rule has a domain that decides when it applies, and the rules are listed on the report's Substitution Rules tab. Configured under Settings, Technical, Actions, Reports.

name: report_text_format_option
summary: Technical option for text-format reports that sets the character encoding of the exported file, such as cp932 for Japanese systems, and how unsupported characters are handled. It also sets the line ending style. It is configured on the report record under Technical Reports and only affects text reports.

name: report_wkhtmltopdf_param
summary: Technical option that lets you add extra command-line settings for the PDF engine to a paper format, such as disabling smart shrinking so a printed form lines up exactly. Parameters are added in developer mode on the Paper Format record under Technical Reports. It is mainly used for pre-printed forms and checks.

name: report_xlsx
summary: Technical base for producing reports as Excel (XLSX) files. Developers write a report class that fills the workbook rows, and users can then download it from the print menu like any other report. It has no separate screen for end users.

name: report_xlsx_helper
summary: Adds helper tools that make building Excel reports easier for developers, with ready-made cell types, formats and layout options on top of the XLSX report base. Other modules use it to offer Excel reports. Users simply see the results as Excel downloads.

name: report_xml
summary: Technical base for producing XML reports, such as files for government or electronic invoicing systems, generated from code or QWeb templates. It can validate the output against an XSD schema and set the XML encoding and declaration. Users do not work with it directly, and other modules build on it.

name: sql_export
summary: Lets administrators export the results of a read-only SQL query to a CSV file from the Dashboards menu, using parameters such as the current company or user. Queries can only read data, and each export records when and by whom it was last run. It is a base for other export options.

name: sql_export_delta
summary: Extends SQL exports so they can output only the rows that changed since the previous run, rather than the full data set. It is turned on per export with a Delta checkbox while the export is still in draft. Useful for syncing data to other systems without resending everything.

name: sql_export_excel
summary: Lets a SQL export produce an Excel file instead of CSV, and can fill an existing Excel template so the Odoo data lands in a chosen sheet and cell position. This is useful when the spreadsheet holds calculations that depend on Odoo data. The template is stored as an attachment on the export.

name: sql_export_mail
summary: Emails the result of a SQL export to chosen users on a schedule. Each export has a list of users to notify, and a scheduled action controls when the email goes out. Several exports can share one scheduled action.

name: sql_request_abstract
summary: Technical base that provides a shared way to store and run read-only SQL queries, with draft and valid states and access limited by group or user. It is a building block for other modules such as SQL Export and BI SQL Editor, and can run against an external database configured on the server. End users do not use it directly.

name: sale_blanket_order
summary: Lets sales teams create a blanket order, a pre-agreed contract to sell a set quantity of products at a fixed price until a validity date or until the quantity runs out. Confirmed blanket orders are then used to create individual sale orders at that price. A Blanket Orders menu in Sales holds the form for customer, salesperson, payment terms, validity date and order lines.

name: sale_order_blanket_order
summary: Extends sales orders so they can act as blanket orders with a validity period, and later call-off orders draw down the blanket quantities and are delivered and invoiced one at a time. The blanket order drives stock and invoicing, and by default stock is only reserved when a call-off is created. A sales setting can make normal sale orders for blanket products create call-offs automatically.

name: sale_order_blanket_order_carrier_auto_assign
summary: Technical glue module for companies that use both blanket orders and automatic carrier assignment. It keeps the delivery fee line out of blanket order call-off matching, so a second call-off is not wrongly rejected with a 'product is not part of linked blanket order' error. There is no separate screen for users.

name: sale_order_blanket_order_stock_prebook
summary: Adds an At Confirm reservation strategy to blanket orders, so stock is reserved for future call-offs as soon as the blanket order is confirmed, starting from its validity start date. This makes sure the quantities are available when customers call them off. The strategy is chosen on the blanket order's reservation strategy field.

name: sale_order_blanket_order_stock_prebook_release
summary: Glue module that makes sure that when pre-booked stock is released for blanket order deliveries, the blanket order's start date sets the priority. Blanket orders that start earlier are served first. Users see this through the move date priority and commitment date on the sales order.

name: partner_prospect
summary: Marks contacts that have never bought anything as Prospects, so they can be told apart from current customers. A contact stops being a prospect once it has a confirmed sale order or a customer invoice, and draft or cancelled quotations do not count. The flag is a checkbox on the contact record.

name: partner_sale_pivot
summary: Adds a Sales Analysis smart button on customer forms that shows that customer's sales, grouped by product in rows and confirmation dates in columns. The button only appears for users in the sales access groups. It gives a quick sales history view without leaving the customer record.

name: portal_sale_list_extra_info
summary: Adds the customer's order reference and the untaxed total to the sales order list that customers see in the portal, so they can find and check orders faster. It also makes it simpler for developers to add more columns later. Customers see these extra columns when they log in to their portal.

name: portal_sale_order_search
summary: Lets customers search their own sales orders and quotations in the portal, including by the order reference they set themselves. The search is added to the portal's order list. It helps customers find an order without contacting the company.

name: portal_sale_personal_data_only
summary: Stops portal users from seeing sales orders that belong to other people in their organization, even when those colleagues follow the order. Each portal user sees only the orders linked to their own contact and its child contacts, along with the related invoices. This keeps documents private between departments.

name: pricelist_cache
summary: Technical background feature that pre-computes prices for every product in every pricelist and stores them in a cache, so a full price catalog for a customer can be produced quickly. A scheduled task rebuilds the cache each day, and new products, pricelists or pricelist rules are cached when created. Other modules and integrations use the cached prices.

name: pricelist_cache_rest
summary: Exposes cached customer prices through a web address that other systems can call with an API key, returning product IDs and prices for a given customer. It is for system integrations rather than people using the screens. The API keys allowed to call it are set on the company.

name: product_customerinfo_elaboration
summary: Lets you set a default elaboration and elaboration note for each customer and product, using the customer info block on the product's Sales tab. When a quotation is created for that customer, the elaboration is filled in automatically on the order lines. It depends on the sale_elaboration module for the elaboration list.

name: product_customerinfo_sale
summary: Shows each customer's own product code and product name on sales order lines, so sales teams can search a product by the customer's code and see that name in the line description. If the product has no minimum quantity from its price rules, the line quantity starts at the customer's minimum quantity. Set up on the product's customer entries.

name: product_form_sale_link
summary: Adds a Sales button on the product form that opens the sale order lines for that product, with a count shown on the button. It lets a user see how and where a product has been sold. The button is on the product form in the Sales app.

name: product_price_category
summary: Adds a Price Category to products so one pricelist rule can apply to a whole group of products, for example all products in one pricing group. The category is set on the product's General Information, and pricelist rules can be applied to it using Applied on. Set up under Sales, Configuration, Pricelists.

name: product_set_sell_only_by_packaging
summary: Warns when a product set is marked as sell only by packaging but some of its lines have no packaging chosen. The product form shows a warning with a link to each affected line so the user can fix them. It connects the packaging-only selling rule with product sets.

name: sale_advance_payment
summary: Lets you record a customer's advance payment against a sale order before the invoice exists, then choose which of those payments to apply when the invoice is created. The payment is entered from a Pay Sale Advance button on the order by picking a journal and an amount. Advance payments appear on the invoice for selection.

name: sale_attached_product
summary: Lets you set up products that are added automatically to a sales order whenever a main product is added, such as a required accessory. The attached lines take the same quantity as the main line, and they can update automatically when the main quantity changes if that setting is on. Configured on the product's Sales tab under Attached products.

name: sale_automatic_workflow
summary: Lets you define automatic workflows that confirm, invoice, validate and send sales orders without manual steps, for example for orders that come from an online shop. A workflow sets the shipping policy, invoice date and sales team, and decides which steps run automatically. Workflows are managed under Sales, Configuration, Automatic Workflow.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_auto_assign
summary: Automatically picks the right automatic workflow when a sales order is created, based on a domain and priority set on each workflow. When a sales order is duplicated, the original workflow is copied only if no automatic match is found. Users do not choose the workflow by hand.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_force_invoiced
summary: Lets an automatic workflow mark matching sales orders as Force Invoiced, so they are treated as fully invoiced when they meet the workflow's domain. The option and domain are set on the workflow under Sales, Configuration, Automatic Workflow. It is used to close orders that will not be invoiced in the normal way.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_job
summary: Runs automatic workflow steps as background queued jobs, one per operation, instead of processing every order in one long scheduled run. Each job is keyed so the same order and step are not queued twice. It is suited to shops with a high volume of orders.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_payment_mode
summary: Links payment modes to automatic workflows, so a sales order that uses a payment mode with a workflow automatically gets that workflow. The workflow is chosen on each payment mode in the invoicing configuration. It is a glue module between payment mode setup and sales automation.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_periodicity
summary: Lets a workflow run on a repeating interval, set in seconds, and shows when it will next run. An option can limit processing to orders created before the last run. It controls how often orders are processed automatically.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_stock
summary: Extends automatic workflows with stock steps, such as choosing whether to ship as products become available or all at once, setting a packing policy, and automatically confirming the delivery order. The workflow also appears on the delivery orders it creates. It is set up in the same configuration as other workflows.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_stock_job
summary: Runs the stock-related workflow steps, such as confirming delivery orders, as background queued jobs rather than one long scheduled run. It works alongside the automatic workflow job module for high-volume shipping.

name: sale_block_no_stock
summary: Stops a sales order from being confirmed when the quantity ordered is more than the stock available by a chosen measure, such as stock available on the delivery date. A wizard then lets the user reduce the quantities or move the extra lines to a new order, and users in an allowed group can confirm anyway. It applies to storable products only.

name: sale_cancel_confirm
summary: Adds an optional free-text reason to the standard sales order cancel dialog, and stores the reason, user and date on the cancelled order. It is enabled per company in Sales settings. Use this when free text is wanted instead of a predefined list of reasons.

name: sale_cancel_reason
summary: Requires a reason whenever a sales order is cancelled. Users pick the reason from a list configured in Sales settings, and the reason is stamped on the order. Mass cancellations can carry a reason too.

name: sale_commercial_partner
summary: Adds hidden stored fields on sales orders for the customer's commercial entity and invoice entity, so orders can be grouped by company rather than by individual contact. Settings can limit invoice and delivery address choices to contacts under the same commercial entity. Use Group by Commercial Entity in the sales lists and reports.

name: sale_company_currency
summary: Shows sales order totals in the company's own currency, so orders in several currencies can be added up correctly in lists. A company currency total column appears in the list view, and the same amount is shown after the total on the form. It helps when comparing sales made in different currencies.

name: sale_confirm_group
summary: Lets administrators choose which security groups may confirm sales orders, separately for each company. Users outside those groups do not see the Confirm button, and trying to confirm anyway raises an error. It is turned on in Sales settings with the Use SO Confirmation Groups checkbox.

name: sale_custom_rounding
summary: Lets a sales order use its own tax calculation rounding method, instead of only the company default. The method can be picked on the order's Other Information tab, or taken from the customer's invoice address setting. It builds on the custom invoice rounding module.

name: sale_delivery_split_date
summary: Splits a confirmed sales order into one delivery order per requested date on its lines, so items due on different days ship separately. Delivery orders can then be searched by scheduled date, which now shows in the delivery list. It builds on the sale order line date module.

name: sale_delivery_state
summary: Shows a delivery status on each sales order, worked out from how much of each line has been delivered. A user can mark an order as fully delivered when the customer cancelled the rest, and service lines and delivery fee lines can be left out of the check. Other modules use this status, which appears on the sales order.

name: sale_discount_display_amount
summary: Shows the money value of a discount on sales orders, not only the percentage. The totals show the total without the discount and the discount amount, with or without tax depending on a setting. Line discounts must be allowed in Sales settings first.

name: sale_elaboration
summary: Lets you add an elaboration, a handling or finishing step such as cutting or engraving, to sales order lines. When the delivery order is validated, an extra surcharge line for the elaboration is added to the sale, and an elaboration route can split the delivery notes. Elaborations and their profiles are set up under Sales Configuration.

name: sale_elaboration_brand
summary: Adds the product brand to the Sale Elaboration report, so the people handling the elaboration can see the brand of each item. It only applies when the product brand module is also installed.

name: sale_exception
summary: Attaches configurable exception flags to sales orders and lines, for example no virtual stock, an empty zip code or a customer warning, so problem orders can be filtered and fixed. It is most useful when importing many orders that may contain errors. Exceptions are defined as rules, and a popup can warn users when they confirm.

name: sale_exception_product_sale_manufactured_for
summary: Blocks a sales order when the customer is not on the list of customers a product may be manufactured for, unless the customer's commercial entity is on that list. It works as a rule in the sale exceptions, so the order shows the problem to be fixed.

name: sale_fixed_discount
summary: Lets sales lines carry a fixed amount discount as well as a percentage discount, and the sales order report shows the fixed discount too. The Discounts option under Pricing in Sales settings must be turned on first. Users choose the discount type on each line.

name: sale_force_invoiced
summary: Lets users mark a sales order as Invoiced even when not everything was invoiced, for example after a customer agrees to a smaller quantity without a credit note, or to clear old orders migrated from an earlier Odoo version. Ticking the Force Invoiced field removes the order from the To Invoice list.

name: sale_force_invoiced_quantity
summary: Adds a Force Invoiced Quantity field to each sales order line that reduces the quantity still to invoice, so the amount to invoice is adjusted without issuing a refund. The field is optional and can be hidden. It builds on the Force Invoiced module.

name: sale_global_discount
summary: Applies global financial discounts to sales orders, such as an early payment or volume discount for the whole order, and passes them through to invoices and accounting. A customer's default global discounts are filled in automatically, and the order footer shows the computed discount amounts. It builds on the base global discount module.

name: sale_invoice_blocking
summary: Lets users block invoicing on a sales order by entering a reason, so no regular invoice can be created until the block is removed. Reasons are kept in a list under Sales Configuration, Sales Orders, Invoicing block reasons. A blocked order shows its reason when someone tries to invoice it.

name: sale_invoice_delivery_state
summary: Lets you set on each customer whether they should be invoiced after partial or full delivery, and checks that the invoice status of each order matches that policy and the delivery status. This helps catch orders invoiced too early or too late. The setting appears on the customer's record.

name: sale_invoice_frequency
summary: Lets you define invoicing frequencies, such as weekly or monthly, and assign one to each customer. Sales orders take the customer's frequency, and orders can be grouped and selected for invoicing by it. Frequencies are created under Sales Configuration, Invoicing frequency.

name: sale_invoice_plan
summary: Lets a sales order use an invoice plan, a schedule of advance and installment invoices each with a date and a percentage of the total. The plan is built on the quotation through a wizard, then invoices are created all at once or one installment at a time. The plan appears on an Invoice Plan tab.

name: sale_invoice_plan_report
summary: Prints the invoice plan on sales order and quotation PDFs when an order uses one, showing each installment's name, due date, percentage and amount in the order currency. It works automatically once installed. Only orders with Use Invoice Plan enabled and plan lines show the section.

name: sale_invoice_policy
summary: Adds an invoicing policy to each sales order, so the whole order can invoice on ordered quantities, delivered quantities, or the product's own setting. The policy is chosen on the order, and a company-wide default can be set in Sales settings. Invoices follow the policy chosen on the order.

name: sale_invoice_product_not_alone
summary: Lets you mark a product as one that cannot be invoiced on its own. Orders made only of such products do not appear in the list of orders ready to invoice. The flag is set on the product's form.

name: sale_invoice_split_payment
summary: Creates separate invoices for sales orders with different payment terms, even when the customer and products are the same. When several orders are invoiced together, they are split by payment term instead of being merged into one invoice. Use it when each payment term needs its own invoice.

name: sale_last_price_info
summary: Shows on each product the last price it was sold at, the date of that sale and the last customer who bought it. This helps sales reps quote consistently. The sales order line also records the order date for this information.

name: sale_line_name_option
summary: Hides the internal product code from sales order lines, so each line shows only the product description. It is turned on per company in Sales settings with the No Product Code in Sale Line Name option. Useful when the internal code should not appear to customers.

name: sale_line_vendor_comment
summary: Adds a Vendor Comment field to sales order lines, for notes meant for the supplier that are kept separate from the line description. It is useful when a line needs an instruction for the vendor.

name: sale_mail_autosubscribe
summary: Automatically adds configured contacts as followers, in copy, of their company's sales orders, so they receive the order emails. On each contact, the Sales Orders option is ticked under the In copy of field. Users do not have to add these contacts by hand.

name: sale_manual_delivery
summary: Lets deliveries be created by hand for long-term orders, so the sales order does not reserve stock by itself. Each delivery gets its own planned date and carrier, and a wizard shows how much has already been planned to ship. It suits projects where the material ships in many parts.

name: sale_mrp_bom
summary: Lets a sales order line specify which bill of materials to use, for example an alternative manufacturing or subcontracting route. When the order is confirmed, the production order uses that bill of materials. Only users with the matching permission can choose it.

name: sale_multi_template_application
summary: Lets you apply more than one quotation template to the same sales order. Lines from earlier templates are kept when another template is chosen, instead of being replaced. The template field is then cleared so the order is not tied to a single partial template.

name: sale_no_portal_button
summary: Removes the access button from sales order notification emails sent to customers who have no portal user, so they are not sent a link they cannot use. Only contacts linked to a user keep the button. It applies when messages are sent from the order chatter.

name: sale_order_amount_to_invoice
summary: Shows the total amount still to be invoiced on quotations and sales orders, on the order lines, the form and the list view. The list and line fields are hidden by default and must be turned on from the list column settings. It helps see what is left to bill.

name: sale_order_archive
summary: Lets you archive locked or cancelled sales orders so they no longer clutter the sales order list, while still being kept. Archived orders can be found with the Archived filter and restored from there. Archiving is done from the list's Action menu.

name: sale_order_cancel_optional_email
summary: Makes cancelling a confirmed sales order happen straight away, without the wizard that offers to email the customer. A separate Send Email and Cancel button opens that wizard when the customer should be told. This prevents cancellation emails from going out by accident.

name: sale_order_carrier_auto_assign
summary: Fills in the delivery carrier on sales orders automatically, either when the order is created or when it is confirmed. On confirmation the delivery cost line is added too. The behavior is set under Sales settings, Shipping.

name: sale_order_disable_user_autosubscribe
summary: Stops the order's salesperson from being added automatically as a follower of every sales order. Other followers are not changed. It is useful when the salesperson should not receive every order notification.

name: sale_order_finish_service
summary: Adds a finished flag to service sales orders, with a Finish or Unfinish button, to mark that the service has been completed or delivered. The button appears once the order is confirmed. The flag is kept on the order and its lines.

name: sale_order_general_discount
summary: Sets one general discount on a sales order and copies it to every line, instead of entering it line by line. Customers can have a default general discount, and each product can opt out of it. The discount is shown on the order and in each line's discount field.

name: sale_order_invoice_amount
summary: Shows the invoiced amount and the amount still to invoice on sales orders, in the totals just above the order total on the form, and as optional columns in the list view. It gives a quick view of billing progress for each order.

name: sale_order_invoicing_finished_task
summary: Lets service tasks control when their sales lines can be invoiced. For a service product set to invoicing control by task, billing waits until the task is marked invoiceable, which can be set on the task or automatically by a project stage. It suits service work billed only once finished.

name: sale_order_invoicing_picking_filter
summary: Lets you create invoices from a sales order using only the products and quantities in chosen delivery orders, instead of the whole order. Deliveries to bill are picked in the invoicing wizard, and if none are selected the normal flow is used. Delivery orders get an invoiced flag.

name: sale_order_line_cancel
summary: Lets users cancel the remaining quantity on a sales order line with a dedicated action, and tracks the cancelled and still-to-deliver quantities. It can either only record the cancelled quantity, or also reduce the ordered quantity. The action is found on the sales order line.

name: sale_order_line_cancel_sale_stock
summary: Cancels only the stock moves for the quantity still to deliver when a line is cancelled, and tracks the cancelled quantity if a line's move is cancelled and nothing else has started. It builds on the order line cancel module and the Inventory app. It is not recommended if ordered quantities can still be edited after confirmation.

name: sale_order_line_chained_move
summary: Keeps a separate stock move for each sales order line when the stock rule says so, rather than letting Odoo merge lines with the same product. Each move can then be traced back to its order line. It is set per stock rule under Inventory Configuration, Rules.

name: sale_order_line_client_order_ref
summary: Adds a Customer Order Number field to each sales order line, carried onto the invoice lines. It is useful when one sales order covers several customer purchase orders. It can be shown on sales and invoice reports through the settings.

name: sale_order_line_date
summary: Adds a delivery commitment date to each sales order line, filled in from the requested date. The date is passed on to the stock moves and pickings, and the order's commitment date is worked out from the lines and the shipping policy. Users see it as Delivery Date on the lines.

name: sale_order_line_date_next_reception
summary: Shows the next expected receipt date for a product on the sales order line when it is out of stock and a purchase is already on the way. This helps promise the customer a realistic delivery date.

name: sale_order_line_delivery_state
summary: Shows a delivery status on each sales order line, based on how much of that line has been delivered. A line can be marked fully delivered when the customer cancelled the remainder, and delivery fee lines are ignored. It builds on the sale delivery state module.

name: sale_order_line_description
summary: Makes sales order lines use only the product's sales description, instead of reference, name and sales description combined. It is turned on in Sales settings under Product Sale Description, and each user needs the matching access right. Useful when quotes should show only the product text.

name: sale_order_line_effective_date
summary: Adds Effective Date, Last Effective Date and Order Commitment Date fields to sales order lines, showing when each line was actually delivered and when it was promised. When a delivery is split by backorder, the dates track the final shipment. The fields appear on the sales order lines.

name: sale_order_line_final_price
summary: Adds a Final Price field to sales order lines, holding the unit price the customer actually pays after discount. Entering a final price works out the discount automatically, while the catalog price stays visible on the quotation. Unit price and discount become read only for anyone who is not a Sales Administrator, so salespeople enter what the customer pays.

name: sale_order_line_input
summary: Lets users work directly with sales order lines in one list, with search, grouping and the ability to create new lines from there. A new line can be attached to an existing order, and if no order is chosen a new order is created. It is found under Sales, Orders, Sales Order Lines.

name: sale_order_line_menu
summary: Adds an Order Lines menu under Sales, Orders, with list views for browsing all sales order lines. It only adds navigation and views, so users can look through lines and filter them without opening each order.

name: sale_order_line_move_to_optional
summary: Lets users move a sales order line into the optional products section, removing it from the main order lines. This is only possible while the order is in Draft or Quotation Sent state. A Move to optional action sits beside each line.

name: sale_order_line_no_print
summary: Lets users hide individual sales order, quotation or invoice lines from the printed report and the customer portal, while keeping them on the internal document. A Display in report checkbox on each line controls this. It is useful for internal or helper lines that the customer should not see.

name: sale_order_line_note
summary: Adds a Note field to each sales order line for free text, such as a remark for the team. It is a simple text field on the line and does not change prices or quantities.
